assets.origin: Exported from Apple Icon Composer, media/brand/PMR.icon, iOS/macOS Default appearance at 1024 x 1024. Three editable vector layers: blue face, terminal prompt, status jewel. The colour layer uses Liam Mendes's supplied vertical gradient, #0080FF to #0057FF with Display P3 stops (0, 0.5, 1) and (0, 0.34, 1). Native lighting and shadows are applied by Icon Composer. No image generation.

Original rounded lowercase vector lettering authored in Paper. Uses Liam Mendes's supplied vertical blue gradient, #0080FF to #0057FF with Display P3 stops (0, 0.5, 1) and (0, 0.34, 1). No image generation.
Official Liam Mendes vector logo from https://cloud.liammendes.co.uk/svg/liammendes.svg, retrieved 15 October 2026. Original paths retained; currentColor resolved to #000000.
Computer plugin screenshot of real pmr monit in native iTerm on macOS, with four isolated local demo services. Captured 15 October 2026. No reconstructed terminal UI.

Computer plugin screenshot of real pmr monit in native iTerm on macOS. camera-sim produces synthetic frames, deliberately exits once, and restarts under pmr; screenshot shows online and one restart. No physical camera or Raspberry Pi footage.

Original Remotion composition rendered from media/video/src/Launch.tsx, Poster, 1920 x 1080. Matches Liam Mendes’s revised Paper poster: centred original vector pmr-wordmark.svg, official liam-mendes.svg at top left, real pmr-dashboard.jpg and black Manrope typography. No terminal icon on this poster.

Real pmr 1.0.0 logs shown in native macOS Terminal, captured with the Computer plugin on 15 October 2026. Three isolated local processes emit explicitly scripted agent-demo events; no model API calls. Timestamped native captures at about one-second intervals retain their timing in this 8-second, 30-fps H.264 clip. Cropped to terminal content; no reconstructed terminal UI.
Still at 3 seconds from pmr-agent-logs.mp4, the real native Terminal capture of scripted local agent-demo processes under pmr. Used in the reduced-motion film.

Computer plugin capture of real pmr 1.0.0 monit in native macOS Terminal, 15 October 2026. Isolated report-worker, archive-worker and checksum-worker processes perform real JSON, gzip and SHA-256 jobs on generated records. Cropped to the dashboard panels; no reconstructed terminal UI.
